notes.title: New Ocean and Visuals!
notes.content: Lovely new ocean, and a bunch of new item icons. Also tweaks and such!

notes.title: Smarter Enemies!
notes.content: New enemies with smarter behavior! A freaking force shield. And more content on the way!

notes.title: Pausing and Yachting
notes.content: You can now pause at any time, move the camera around freely, and select crew members to attack targets. There are a few new UI elements, like the target icon and the in-game health bars. Plus, if you survive long enough and have plundered enough gold, you can upgrade to the new yacht.

notes.title: Reworks and features and such
notes.content: The game is, at least, slightly more playable. And now you can select how your sailors target enemies. There were a bunch of other feature changes, but I forgot what they were so good luck.

notes.title: Super awesome update royale
notes.content: Added sailor stats, some new encounters, and Ryan Reynolds!
New spawn system, new player ships, a bunch of fixes and a dash of love.

notes.title: Epic stuff and fixes
notes.content: Basically it's a little more playable and also now there are a couple of silly islands
